products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai is an enterprise software company that describes itself as a leader in enterprise AI, focused on helping businesses improve customer service and employee productivity through what it calls agentic AI. Its core offering is the Kore.ai Agent Platform 2.0, which the company positions as an AI-programmable platform for building, orchestrating, deploying, and managing AI agents across customer and employee-facing workflows. The platform combines scripted and reasoning AI on shared infrastructure, supports multi-agent orchestration with parallel execution and independent fault recovery, and is designed to connect to business systems through agentic RAG search. The company emphasizes portability, noting that agent definitions are not tied to any specific underlying large language model.

On the governance and compliance side, the platform enforces controls at the runtime layer rather than through AI-interpreted instructions, logs 100 percent of interactions for audit purposes, and includes role-based access controls and guardrails. The company states that every workflow can be validated before deployment. Kore.ai has been recognized as a leader in the Forrester Wave for Cognitive Search Platforms 2025, where it received the highest score possible across 11 criteria and ranked highest in the strategy category, and it also appears in Forrester Wave evaluations for conversational AI in both employee services and customer service, as well as the Everest Group Agentic AI Products PEAK Matrix Assessment.

The held facts note that Kore.ai serves more than 400 Fortune 2000 customers and list its primary product category as enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration. Strategic partnerships referenced on the company's site include Microsoft and an unnamed implementation partner operating on AWS infrastructure. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
